SELECT i.user_id AS surveyUserId, i.real_name AS surveyUserName, sum(s.risk_case_num) as riskCaseNum, sum(s.insurance_check_case_num) as insuranceCheckCaseNum, sum(s.risk_check_case_num) as riskCheckCaseNum, sum(s.score) as score, avg(s.efficiency) as efficiency, avg(s.positive_rate) as positiveRate, avg(s.return_rate) as returnRate, avg(s.loss_efficiency_rate) as lossEfficiencyRate, sum(s.investigation_money) as investigationMoney, sum(s.direction_num) as directionNum FROM survey_investigator i left join survey_investigator_user_report s on s.survey_user_id= i.user_id WHERE 1 = 1 and i.delete_flag =0
and i.org_id = #{surveyOrgId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
and i.user_id = #{surveyUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
GROUP BY i.user_id
order by sum(s.score) desc,sum(s.investigation_money) desc
order by sum(s.score) asc
order by sum(s.score) desc
order by sum(s.investigation_money) asc
order by sum(s.investigation_money) desc
order by sum(s.insurance_check_case_num) asc,sum(s.risk_check_case_num) asc
order by sum(s.insurance_check_case_num) desc,sum(s.risk_check_case_num) desc
order by sum(s.direction_num) asc
order by sum(s.direction_num) desc
order by avg(s.positive_rate) asc
order by avg(s.positive_rate) desc
order by avg(s.efficiency) asc
order by avg(s.efficiency) desc
order by avg(s.loss_efficiency_rate) asc
order by avg(s.loss_efficiency_rate) desc

select t.user_id surveyUserId,t.real_name surveyUserName,ifnull(a.score,0) score,ifnull(b.num,0) insuranceCheckCaseNum,ifnull(c.num,0) directionNum,ifnull(d.num,0) sunNum, ifnull(e.aging_real,0) efficiency,ifnull(f.num,0) lossNum,ifnull(g.num,0) as returnNum,ifnull(0,0) as investigationMoney, ifnull(cc.num,0) hege,ifnull(ccc.num,0) you,ifnull(cccc.num,0) cha, ifnull(cc.score,0) hegeScore,ifnull(ccc.score,0) youScore,ifnull(cccc.score,0) chaScore from survey_investigator t left join ( select b.user_id from bus_user_role b where b.role_id = 50 group by b.user_id ) ur on t.user_id = ur.user_id left join survey_franchisee f on t.org_id = f.id left join ( select c.survey_user_id,sum(c.score) score from survey_investigator_case c left join survey_risk_case_info r on c.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where c.delete_flag = 0 and r.delete_flag = 0
group by c.survey_user_id ) a on t.user_id = a.survey_user_id
left join ( select a.survey_user_id,count(1) num from ( select c.survey_user_id,c.survey_info_id from survey_investigator_case c left join survey_risk_case_info r on c.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where c.delete_flag = 0 and r.delete_flag = 0
group by c.survey_user_id,c.survey_info_id ) a group by a.survey_user_id ) b on t.user_id = b.survey_user_id left join ( select c.survey_user_id,count(1) num from survey_case_direction d left join survey_investigator_case c on d.survey_investigator_case_id = c.id left join survey_risk_case_info r on c.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where c.delete_flag = 0 and r.delete_flag = 0 and d.delete_flag = 0
group by c.survey_user_id ) c on t.user_id = c.survey_user_id left join ( select c.survey_user_id,count(1) num,sum(d.score) score from survey_case_direction d left join survey_investigator_case c on d.survey_investigator_case_id = c.id left join survey_risk_case_info r on c.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where c.delete_flag = 0 and r.delete_flag = 0 and d.delete_flag = 0 and d.evaluate = 1
group by c.survey_user_id ) cc on t.user_id = cc.survey_user_id left join ( select c.survey_user_id,count(1) num,sum(d.score) score from survey_case_direction d left join survey_investigator_case c on d.survey_investigator_case_id = c.id left join survey_risk_case_info r on c.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where c.delete_flag = 0 and r.delete_flag = 0 and d.delete_flag = 0 and d.evaluate = 2
group by c.survey_user_id ) ccc on t.user_id = ccc.survey_user_id left join ( select c.survey_user_id,count(1) num,sum(d.score) score from survey_case_direction d left join survey_investigator_case c on d.survey_investigator_case_id = c.id left join survey_risk_case_info r on c.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where c.delete_flag = 0 and r.delete_flag = 0 and d.delete_flag = 0 and d.evaluate = 3
group by c.survey_user_id ) cccc on t.user_id = cccc.survey_user_id left join ( select c.survey_user_id,count(1) as num from survey_investigator_case c left join survey_risk_case_info r on c.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where c.delete_flag = 0 and r.delete_flag = 0
and c.is_sun = 1 group by c.survey_user_id ) d on t.user_id = d.survey_user_id left join ( select c.survey_user_id,avg(abs(c.aging_real)) as aging_real from survey_investigator_case c left join survey_risk_case_info r on c.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where c.delete_flag = 0 and r.delete_flag = 0
group by c.survey_user_id ) e on t.user_id = e.survey_user_id left join ( select c.survey_user_id,count(1) as num from survey_investigator_case c left join survey_risk_case_info r on c.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where c.delete_flag = 0 and r.delete_flag = 0
and c.aging_over > 0 group by c.survey_user_id ) f on t.user_id = f.survey_user_id left join ( select c.survey_user_id,count(1) as num from survey_investigator_case c left join survey_risk_case_info r on c.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id where c.delete_flag = 0 and r.delete_flag = 0
and c.return_state > 0 group by c.survey_user_id ) g on t.user_id = g.survey_user_id where t.delete_flag = 0 and f.bus_type in (2,3) and ur.user_id is not null
and (f.id = #{surveyOrgId,jdbcType=BIGINT} or f.parent_id = #{surveyOrgId,jdbcType=BIGINT})
and t.user_id = #{surveyUserId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
order by a.score desc
order by a.score asc
order by a.score desc
order by a.score asc
order by a.score desc
order by b.num asc
order by b.num desc
order by c.num asc
order by c.num desc
order by d.num / b.num asc
order by d.num / b.num desc
order by e.aging_real asc
order by e.aging_real desc
order by f.num / b.num asc
order by f.num / b.num desc

order by ccc.num / c.num desc
order by cc.num / c.num asc

order by cccc.num / c.num desc
